faq_items.question: How long does shipping take?
faq_items.answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days. Free shipping is automatically applied to orders over ₹999.

faq_items.question: Can I return a product?
faq_items.answer: Yes, we accept returns within 14 days of delivery. The item must be unused, in its original packaging, and with all tags intact.

faq_items.question: How do I track my order status?
faq_items.answer: Go to your Orders page by tapping the Orders tile in your Account, or by navigating to /orders. There, you can view the status of each order: Placed, Shipped, or Delivered.

faq_items.question: Who is the seller on Kura?
faq_items.answer: Kura is a single-seller boutique, meaning all products are directly handpicked, verified, and shipped by me (the store owner). This guarantees consistent quality and support.
